# PR #262 — performance PASS

Head: f9cb2d15c8b0adab09d0dcb46182fcd3e19c466d.
Reviewer: pij-public-cobra. Round 1 of 2 (C34).
Answers original request: 01a1f28e-c727-7d82-9b89-eecfa7cf0e0a.

## Decision

PASS for the normal-use resource contract. Explicit/on-demand priority setting has no idle cost, no new polling, and no retained wrapper process. Real callers at niceness0/19/20 produced commands at19/19/20. R257-002 remains an explicitly acknowledged C34 follow-up, not a claim of failure-path coverage or a fixed edge.

## Exact-head binding

Independently confirmed local HEAD and PR head match the full SHA above. `git range-diff 93ede914..affdf009 4c899c0a..f9cb2d15` showed: commit1 changed only hunk context beside #261's recipe; build_stamps fixture commit2 identical; commit3 new. Inspected full commit3: its only change replaces update-copilot's bare `@nice -n 19 node ...` with `@harness/scripts/nice19.sh node ...`. This resolves the convergence issue found during the held review. Latest check(22), check(24), delivers, rust-lint and rust-test were successful. Rust execution here is CI evidence only.

## Cost and lifecycle

- At rest: zero launches/s. No new daemon launch site, timer, hook, statusline or seat-scaled loop.
- Per nice19 invocation: one absolute `/bin/ps`, a shell-wrapper entry, and optional absolute `/usr/bin/nice` below19. Shell and nice exec into the requested command; neither remains as an extra parent. The transient ps child is real overhead, not zero cost.
- Count per wrapper/cargo command, NOT universally per composite recipe: shared-build now performs N priority queries for N cargo commands instead of one query per acquired batch. clippy+test therefore uses2 versus1. Smoke has a build wrapper plus a smoke-runner wrapper. Existing lock-wait polling (20s) is unchanged and does not call nice19 per poll.
- update-copilot gains the same one-query wrapper on explicit invocation. Its existing update/contract/version subprocess behavior is unchanged by the replacement commit. Real updater-internal work remains unmeasured; no real update was allowed.
- Priority lowering is a one-directional brake: removing it permits more aggressive scheduling. This is not a new scheduling policy based on an unrelated input.

## Executed on replacement head

1. `just worktree-deps`:165 existing main dependency links created; no package installation or compilation.
2. `just test harness/scripts/nice19.test.ts harness/scripts/recipe-cost.test.ts harness/scripts/update-copilot.test.ts`:25/25 across3 files,5.36s. No outer nice. The actual merged justfile passes the10-case recipe-cost sensor; nice19 contributes5 cases and updater10.
3. Actual `just update-copilot` recipe smoke with ALL executable boundaries replaced by private disposable stubs: COPILOT_BIN, PIJ_COPILOT_UPDATE_CMD and PIJ_COPILOT_SDK_CONTRACT_CMD. Both version probes, update stub and contract stub observed niceness19. Recipe exited0. The stub report claimed a contract pass only to exercise success control flow; no real SDK verification or record write occurred. harness/copilot-sdk-verified.json SHA1 stayed43f34eceb2d573463c94ccf3b5413cbfd5623751 before/after. target remained absent. Temporary stubs were removed.

## Retained unchanged-code evidence at affdf00

Explicitly prior-head, not rerun here: outer-niced nice19/shared-build/recipe-cost suite37/37,24.64s, including signal/tree-drain cases against fake cargo. Real direct priority probes showed0→19,19→19,20→20 with identical before/after PIDs6674/6679/6693: no retained wrapper parent. Literal spaces, quotes, empty argv and shell-looking text preserved; exit37 propagated; SIGTERM reached the same exec PID6706 and returned-15. Range-diff establishes this wrapper/shared-build code is unchanged in the replacement head.

During that prior-head suite, a20s machine sample observed205.7 new processes/s, no observed daemon children. Concurrent daemon PID36530 spawn counters stayed2334→2334 over20.040s (2026-11-19T06:48:35.980542Z–06:48:56.020279Z), all per-site deltas0. Uncontrolled fleet observations, not a causal before/after PR reduction; no daemon CPU/RSS delta claim.

## Follow-up and proof limits

R257-002: nice19.sh still substitutes current=0 if ps output is empty/invalid. This can stack priority again under a niced caller; a negative-priority caller with a failed read cannot establish the>=19 invariant. Requester explicitly retains it as the C34 follow-up; correctness reviewer was notified. No real negative-niceness parent or ps-failure runtime was exercised. The measured normal paths do not prove this edge.

No local real cargo, build, real Copilot update, real --record operation, full harness gate or seat reload. Source unchanged by reviewer. No new permanent tests or scaffolding introduced.
